Fintech innovation is driving global change in the
traditional financial services industry. And the UK
(London in particular) is a global fintech hub, with
the likes of challenger banks, P2P lenders, and
cryptocurrency wallets all making waves.
Since our records began, back in 2011, the UK’s
fintech sector has seen meteoric growth. An
astonishing £2.4b of fintech investment was
deployed in 2019 alone, across 210 funding
rounds. 
Mapping out the UK’s high-growth fintech ecosystem, this report spotlights some of the
most exciting startups in the financial technology space:
